semantic_review.review: EffectCore contains prepared effects and semantic information/result pullbacks. Step adds arbitrary admission implying preparation. Guarded and literal/exact profiles are explicit certificates, not evaluation defaults. The normalization, strict strengthening and invalid weakening examples separate exactness, consistency and refinement. Evaluator outcomes retain candidate-specific refusal, unresolved work and budget exhaustion.
semantic_review.boundary: No general coverage or preferred evaluation/search strategy follows from knowledge preservation.

semantic_review.review: The quiver retains complete admitted candidates. Mathlib Paths supplies the free category and unique extension to any target category. Existing endpoint runs are equivalent to paths. Ordered monoid accounts specialize the free interpretation. The actual trace relation admits precisely the readouts respecting its generating equations; equal endpoints alone do not identify events. Principal answers mutually factor on the stated source terms.
semantic_review.boundary: No unique residual factorization or general coequalizer is asserted. Trace erasure uses the selected transport/independence relation.

semantic_review.review: Prepared payloads precede admission; success records require admitted events. Target-domain compatibility supplies the Escape laws. Whole decorated runs lift uniquely from an initial record and erase to their base run. The actual base-refused/constrained-admitted example retains payload and creates a new receipt. Empty choices remain possible. Equal-world/different-record and shared/isolated or enumeration/commitment examples establish the operational-state and handler distinctions.
semantic_review.boundary: A record read by execution is explicit state. Total publication data alone supplies no transport law; independence is conditional.

semantic_review.review: The real shared module elaborates to the validated 29-constructor entry. Lexer/grammar/packed-policy and structural lowering connect to interpreted effect/admission queries. Canonical print/parse recovery covers every parse in the separated structural profile and versioned documents reject mismatches. ABT scope, fresh schema opening, capture, quotation and origin/candidate identity have concrete controls. Source execution preserves and reflects transitions and finite paths in the connected profiles, including administrative lowering and spurious-target counterexamples. Exact codecs are restricted to represented carriers closed under every preparation; candidate coverage and faithfulness separately yield whole-run reflection and uniqueness. The unbounded counted-store consumer supplies actual codecs, executable decisions and finite-run coverage.
semantic_review.boundary: The mathematical reader is a grammar specification related to packed results, not a new verified native parser. Generic backward realization retains canonical policy/candidate-coverage hypotheses. No serialization of all mathematical function-valued native states is claimed.

semantic_review.review: The coalgebra is constructed from actual admitted events and equated with the independent operational GSOS coalgebra through correspondence. The existing finite-branching final-bialgebra law yields compositional observation and contextual bisimilarity. Two futures differ in their subsequent action availability. The multiplicity and syntactic-inspection controls establish the observation boundary.
semantic_review.boundary: The profile is first-order and set-observed with finite successors per action. It does not silently cover general binding, reflection, arbitrary side predicates or multiplicity-sensitive observations.

semantic_review.review: Independent HOL definitions are read against exact received source equations and interpreted on constructed inhabited raw carriers with valid indexed fibres. Invalid sentinels do not fill empty native fibres. Prepared effects, optional exactness, explicit admission, complete native event packets and paths agree in both directions. Loaded pullback on continuation carriers agrees with dependent record updates. Actual publication and receipt consumers retain names, frame transport and base refusal. The typed receiver checks actual mixed-history roots and the 24 earlier definition identities; separate native replay validates the proof streams and rejects tampering.
semantic_review.boundary: Concrete whole-history execution is distinguished from a closed kernel reduction of that entire replay. Native C/ISA implementation refinement remains a separate consumer obligation.

semantic_review.review: The shared constructors and clients use the factored interface. All 3323 internal dependency sources, including 1055 affected sources, have current successful warning-as-error receipts. The original acceptance declarations retain their stated hypotheses and matching source pins; headline axioms, syntax, authored-source identity, native proof streams and readable artifacts remain independently qualified.
